# 3 bed apartment for sale

> Property Partners Purtill are thrilled to present Apartment 21, Killegland Meadows. A bright and airy owner occupied, three bedroom apartment, in well maintained condition, located on the ground floor of this established and popular development in the heart of Ashbourne. No. 21 benefits from two balconies over looking the park and is ready for immediate occupancy.

## Fakta
- Typ: apartment
- Druh nabídky: sale
- Dispozice: 3 bed
- Plocha: 94 m²
- Energetická náročnost: B
- Lokalita: Apartment 21, Killegland Meadows, Ashbourne
- Cena: 275 000 €
